raw_response: Goldman Sachs characterized the Basel III Endgame proposal as "fluid" and noted that if implemented as proposed, it would have varying effects on different businesses, with certain activities meaningfully impacting end users. In contrast, Citi described the situation by stating there was still uncertainty regarding what the final rules would be and their implementation timing, noting that they, like the rest of the industry, needed to work through the implications while awaiting further clarity from regulators.
